Following earlier backend code appearances supporting GWM's Tank vehicle lineup, Apple appears to be preparing to extend this feature to another brand under the automaker. Here are the details.

Car Keys is reportedly set to support Apple Wallet and is coming soon to Haval models

A few weeks ago, Apple added backend references showing that GWM's Tank lineup would soon support Apple Wallet's Car Keys feature, allowing users to lock, unlock, and start compatible vehicles using an iPhone or Apple Watch.

Now, according to a discovery by Aaron Perris on X, similar references have also appeared for Haval—another brand belonging to the same Chinese automaker:

Although several Haval models under GWM already offer CarPlay, none currently support Apple's standalone Car Keys feature.

Once support rolls out, compatible Haval models will join the ranks of more than 50 models that already support Car Keys, including vehicles from BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Kia, Genesis, Toyota, and Rivian.

To learn more about the Car Keys feature in Apple Wallet and view the full list of compatible vehicles, click here.
